doc.title: Ralph Humphrey interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003

title: The odd time signatures: three and two-thirds over four
summary: Humphrey explains that 3 2/3 over 4 is another way of writing eleven eight.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well explain to me if you would, the time signatures with the fractions.

Okay. Well there’s one in particular, it’s called three and two-thirds over four. So if you think of the number three and two-thirds of a three, so three threes and two-thirds of a three is eleven. So really it’s another way of expressing eleven eight.
Yeah. Gives it a certain panache.
